title: E. Howard Hunt's Everglades group burned out by marshals
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of E. Howard Hunt's Everglades group burned out by marshals, about 1963 at Everglades, Florida, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Then a second group, the ones in the Everglades, the under the leazison of E Howard Hunt.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and activist, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a second group hiding out in the Florida Everglades in 1963, run through E. Howard Hunt, a CIA officer. Sheehan says US marshals, under Attorney General Robert Kennedy, burned that camp out. He tells it as part of a story of CIA-linked groups clashing with the Kennedy brothers.
